row.notes: In Game_ErsSystem_HandleVehicleNewLap: add rax,8; cmp rax,r8; jne 0x1425180f0, the path of an entry whose vehicle id does not match (fall-through of je 0x14251810c at 0x1425180fe); continues the participant search or returns 0 at 0x142518109 after the last entry. Reads only rax (the entry slot) and r8 (vector end). The rip target of core's ERS new-lap guard; never hooked.

verify.notes: V1184 sigcheck --only game.ers_new_lap_next_vehicle: OK hits=1 match=0x1425180d0 target=0x142518100 (anchor 0x30, 57 bytes, no wildcards, expect 4883C008 4C39C0). Disasm: 0x142518100 add rax,8; 0x142518104 cmp rax,r8; 0x142518107 jne 0x1425180f0; fall-through 0x142518109 xor eax,eax; ret, so after the last entry it returns 0. Reached in the original code only as the fall-through of je 0x14251810c at 0x1425180fe (the non-matching entry path); no other branch in the function or in the .xtls rel32 scan targets it. It reads only rax and r8 and the flags come from its own add/cmp, so arriving from the lookup site with any r9/flags behaves the same as a non-matching entry (rdx/rcx preserved for the next iteration and the match path).
